To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) robust rate adaptation can guarantee a fixed target outage performance, even in the presence of imperfect CSI, (2) the proposed robust PF scheduling scheme can provide a balance between system performance and user fairness, even in the case of delayed decoding acknowledgements and imperfect CSI, (3) the performance of the robust PF scheduler is superior to the conventional PF scheme, which is not robust to CSI imperfections and delayed decoding acknowledgements.
robust rate adaptation as a well as robust PF-scheduling are able to account for channel estimation errors, feedback delays and decoding delays.
robust rate adaptation and robust scheduling are able to mitigate the performance degradations caused by CSI imperfections and delayed decoding acknowledgements, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the robust rate adaptation and scheduling of multi-user wireless communication systems, where CSI is impaired by imperfect channel estimation and delayed feedback.
the development of robust and delay aware scheduling algorithms, which can be used in centralized cloud based wireless networks.
robust rate adaptation and scheduling in wireless fading channels with CSI imperfections.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed robust rate adaptation and PF scheduler provide a significant performance improvement over the state of the art solutions, which are not able to account for CSI imperfections.
robust PF scheduling is a viable alternative for conventional PF scheduling in practical setups.
the proposed solutions can be used to increase the spectral efficiency of wireless communication systems by exploiting diversity gains, while maintaining the quality of experience of the users.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
robust rate adaptation and scheduling with imperfect CSI are presented for wireless fading channels.
the proposed robust PF scheduling scheme, which accounts for CSI imperfections, is able to provide a high degree of fairness among the users while maintaining a good spectral efficiency.
robust PF scheduling with imperfect CSI is able to provide a good balance between system throughput and user fairness in practical setups with CSI imperfections.
The main takeaway from our work is that
robust PF scheduling can provide a substantial gain in the system performance, compared to conventional scheduling, even if CSI is imperfect.
, by using a robust scheduler, CSI imperfections do not necessarily lead to a degradation of user fairness.
, by accounting for CSI imperfections in the design phase of the scheduling algorithm, substantial performance improvements can be achieved.
